title: calibration.json
description: Pixel-to-metre transform for one fixed camera position. Produced by M1 (owner B). Parent PRD 5.1, as amended by edge PRD A2.

homography.description: 3x3 matrix mapping image pixels to the ground plane, row-major.

held_out.description: true if this point was excluded from the fit and used only to measure rms_error_m.

rms_error_m.description: Residual on held-out reference points, in metres. Above 0.5 the calibration is rejected: a wrong calibration is worse than none, because it looks fine. Edge PRD 4.3.

valid_region_px.description: AMENDMENT A2. Image-space polygon inside which the projection is trusted. A detection whose ground-contact point falls outside it is discarded before tracking.

max_range_m.description: AMENDMENT A2. Ground-plane distance from the origin beyond which projections are discarded.

method.description: How the real-world distances were obtained, and how far they are trusted. Edge PRD 4.2 — a judge asking 'how do you know that is 3.5 metres?' gets an answer instead of a shrug.
